ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low macro-level contrast; dominated by low-intensity (black/dark gray) pixels with sparse high-intensity (white) clusters localized at distal tips and specific scar sites.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly solid black contiguous field. Small high-contrast white clusters are mapped to the extreme distal tips and irregular white linear and circular disruptions are scattered across the central surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex; approximate 50-degree aperture relative to the horizontal axis of the fluke base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire continuous trailing edge of both lobes, characterized by small jagged peaks and shallow valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the posterior margins, sweeping from the median notch toward the distal tips which exhibit an upward/outward taper.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized exclusively on the apex of the left and right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple faint, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the dark field, most visible on the lower right lobe and central-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: One prominent, isolated white circular ring scar located in the mid-region of the left lobe; one small circular yellowish/white spot near the center base of the fluke.
other_distinctive_markers: The highly defined circular ring-shaped scar on the upper-mid region of the left lobe represents a unique geometric mark.
